title: Big Time Alaskan Fishing Adventures

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: For those looking for a truly unique experience, the Kenai River float and fish adventure offers an unforgettable way to explore the heart of Alaska. As you float down the Kenai River, you’ll be surrounded by stunning landscapes and wildlife, including eagles, moose, and bears. The river’s glacier-blue waters offer the perfect backdrop for fishing, with various stops at fishing holes along the way to catch salmon. This relaxing float allows you to enjoy nature at your own pace while also providing an exciting opportunity to reel in your catch. If you’re an angler or someone looking for a peaceful yet adventurous day in the wild, the Kenai River float and fish is an experience you don’t want
